translations.web: Don’t be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you?
translations.bsb: do not bring hastily to court. Otherwise, what will you do in the end when your neighbor puts you to shame?
translations.kjv: Go not forth hastily to strive, lest thou know not what to do in the end thereof, when thy neighbour hath put thee to shame.
translations.asv: Go not forth hastily to strive, Lest thou know not what to do in the end thereof, When thy neighbor hath put thee to shame.
